title: Feuerbach theorem proof via inversion centered at Feuerbach point

problemStatement.formal: \text{Under inversion at F, the incircle and nine-point circle map to parallel lines}
problemStatement.plain: The classical inversive proof of Feuerbach's theorem: inversion centered at the Feuerbach point sends both circles to parallel lines, from which external tangency of excircles follows.
whyMatters: Provides an elegant synthetic proof alternative to coordinate computation
Illuminates the deep projective symmetry in Feuerbach's theorem
The parallel lines picture makes the excircle tangency visually immediate
